# Redition Pharma Ltd.

> Redition Pharma Ltd. is a WHO-GMP and Revised Schedule M certified pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer based in Surat, Gujarat, India, specializing in high-potency neurovascular therapeutics, neuropathic analgesics, microvascular protectors, and institutional hospital supply.

Redition Pharma operates advanced Grade C/D automated manufacturing facilities with 100% monograph HPLC pre-production assays, Zone IVb stability validation, and statutory batch-wise Certificate of Analysis (COA) compliance.

## Core Pharmaceutical Formulations

- [ADNOSINE-108 Tablets](https://www.reditionpharma.com/product/adnosine-108): Adenosine 5-Monophosphate (AMP) 2.5mg, Decarboxylated L-Arginine 2.5mg, and L-Carnosine 25.0mg for neurovascular microcirculation and cellular ATP revitalization.
- [MACSINE-109 Tablets](https://www.reditionpharma.com/product/macsine-109): 9-in-1 multi-mechanism neurotrophic complex (Alpha Lipoic Acid 100mg, Benfotiamine 100mg, Methylcobalamin 1500mcg) for diabetic neuropathy and myelin remodeling.
- [PREDY-NT 37.5/10 Tablets](https://www.reditionpharma.com/product/predy-nt): Schedule H neuropathic analgesic combining sustained-release Pregabalin (37.5mg) with Nortriptyline HCl (10mg) for 24-hour nerve pain relief.
- [QLONG-GOLD Tablets](https://www.reditionpharma.com/product/qlong-gold): Dual nitric oxide precursor and bioenergetic adaptogen tablet with Biopeprine bioavailability enhancer.
- [ADNOCAR-DS Syrup](https://www.reditionpharma.com/product/adnocar-ds): High-concentration pediatric neurodevelopment syrup (L-Carnosine 200mg, DHA 550mg, EPA 200mg, Co-Q10 100mg per 5ml) for cognitive and language support (FSSAI Lic. 12116801000249).

## Manufacturing & Quality Infrastructure

- [4-Tier Quality Validation System](https://www.reditionpharma.com/#quality): Monograph HPLC testing, ISO Class 5 cleanrooms, Zone IVb climatic stability chambers, and statutory batch COA certification.
- [WHO-GMP Schedule M Facility](https://www.reditionpharma.com/#about): Comprehensive oral solid dose and pediatric oral suspension manufacturing facility in Surat, Gujarat.
- [Quality Test Report & COA Verification](https://www.reditionpharma.com/#contact): Batch release documentation, microbial assays, and heavy metal screening reports for institutional clients.

## Institutional & Commercial Supply

- [Hospital Formulary & Tender Procurement](https://www.reditionpharma.com/#contact): Rate contracts, hospital formulary tie-ups, multi-tier state tenders, and dedicated institutional batch allocation.
- [Nationwide Distribution Network](https://www.reditionpharma.com/#distribution): Cold-chain and temperature-controlled logistics across key pan-India hospital corridors.
- [Regulatory & Licensing Dossier](https://www.reditionpharma.com/#about): Central FSSAI License, WHO-GMP Certificate, and Revised Schedule M compliance documentation.
